> **Do not open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.**
> Please follow the private reporting process in [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md).

**Summary**
A short description of the suspected vulnerability. Keep sensitive details out of this public form; use the private channel in SECURITY.md for full details.

**Affected component**
- [ ] `contracts/alert-registry`
- [ ] `contracts/watcher-registry`
- [ ] `bindings/`
- [ ] Other / unsure

**Contract version or commit**
The release tag, deployed contract ID, or commit hash you tested against.

**Impact (high level)**
What an attacker could do if this is exploited (for example: unauthorized admin change, bypassed watcher authorization, storage corruption).
